title: Build tokens and components before screens
trigger: A new direction starts and the project has no design system.
goal: Screens can be composed of refs only.
outcome: Tokens and base components exist with usage notes and show in the Design System view.

example.name: btn-primary
example.usage: Primary action, at most one per screen.

steps.action: Sets color, spacing, radius and type tokens with set_tokens
Writes base components with variants via write_html kind component
Adds usage metadata to each component with set_meta
Reviews tokens as swatches and components side by side
